I reviewed the draft sample collection today. Personal should hold routines and outings, Learning should hold reading reflections, and Studio should hold project discussions and decisions.

Alex Morgan's Pine Ridge journal mentions me, but that does not make it a Studio meeting. A shared person is a connection between documents, not proof that both documents describe the same project.

I recommend keeping the three collection names unchanged. I also suggested adding a visible synthetic-data label to every source preview. Alex has not yet confirmed that suggestion in these notes.
